note: Deck 725 (3x2 sheet, UniqueBack: front = male portrait, back = female portrait; same text on both). One Advisor may be chosen per Round (optional, Preparation phase, Leadership holder has the final word on whose); its ability is used once by exhausting the stated token. Advisors cannot be swapped. Each player takes one Advisor; unused ones return to the box. Responsibility sheets only split bookkeeping between players, the digital game automates them.

advisors.title: Social Advisor
advisors.text: Reveal 3 Dusk cards. You may choose 1 to place on the Dusk discard pile without carrying out its effect. Place the other 2 back in the Dusk deck. Cards with the red Dusk discard pile symbol cannot be chosen.

callToRise.text: Draw 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 Citizen cards if you have at least 1 / 2 / 4 / 6 Hope tokens.
